title: AgentTesla Stealer Analysis Part 1
summary: Agent Tesla is a widely-used .NET-based infostealer that steals credentials, browser data, clipboard contents, and keystrokes while silently maintaining persistence on infected Windows hosts. In this analysis, I reverse-engineer a recent AgentTesla sample to uncover its behavior, string-decryption logic, anti-analysis techniques, registry manipulations, and persistence methods.
author: Abhay Bhat
